text:
Gold Price in 1983
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1983, the LBMA gold price fell 23.4% between 1983-01-31 ($500) and 1983-12-29 ($382). The highest sampled price was $500 in January and the lowest was $382 in October. The mean of these observations was $418. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
